protocol.scope: fixed locations and zero-offset training-selected IDs; no geographic search, no cross-prior sharing; conditional on identities
protocol.training: original training mask; training-only robust CFO profile, not CFO integration
protocol.scoring: normalized t4 residual density, timing marginalized; conditional independent observations approximation; original reused test mask
protocol.age_prior: historical orbit-space equivalent epoch proxy, not a calibrated Doppler-time prior
protocol.young_sensitivity: age<12h t4 scale 0.25s is an explicit UNCALIBRATED hypothesis; main arm retains pooled historical fallback
protocol.optional_clock: normal sigma=1 s truncated at +/-3 s, sensitivity assumption not clock calibration
